nodes.label: Identity Model Requirements (FR-1..5)
nodes.rationale: Requires stable UUID identity per tracked entity, UUID↔internal ID mapping, reuse of existing {entity}_uuid fields, no replacement of integer PKs, and distinction of five identity types.

nodes.label: Identifier Intake Requirements (FR-6..11)
nodes.rationale: Governs acceptance of provider UUIDs per policy, minting new UUIDs, business-key resolution, retention of provider keys, authority key recording, and administrable identity policy enforcement.

nodes.label: Idempotency and Mapping Requirements (FR-12..14)
nodes.rationale: Same accepted identifier across repeated submissions must return same resolved identity; prevents duplicate allocation within same source scope; supports stable lookup of all mapping types.

nodes.label: Domain Modeling Requirements (FR-15..20)
nodes.rationale: Supports provider-owned, shared metadata, and relationship entities; requires reconciliation for shared metadata; FR-20 mandates rejection with diagnostics for unmatched classifiers rather than silent allocation.

nodes.label: Submission and Traceability Requirements (FR-21..23)
nodes.rationale: Groups related identity actions under submission concept; preserves submission context for auditing; maintains relationship between submission, identifiers, and resolved identities.

nodes.label: Update Foundation Requirements (FR-24..25)
nodes.rationale: Maintains identity state for aggregate-level change detection; keeps identity allocation logic independent of business-data mutation logic.

nodes.label: Binding Set Requirements (FR-26)
nodes.rationale: Bindings from an identity resolution batch are grouped into a Binding Set confirmed or rejected as an atomic unit.

nodes.label: Change Request Completeness (FR-27)
nodes.rationale: All entities referenced by a Change Request must have resolved identities through confirmed Binding Sets before the CR can be applied to SEAD; applies to both external and internal origins.
